findings.text: The new condition leaves versions 14.17.0 to 14.x on arm64 instead of x64. Official darwin-arm64 binaries only exist from v16, so `nvm install 14.21.3` on an Apple Silicon Mac now requests a `darwin-arm64` tarball that doesn't exist and fails with a 404. Before this change it fell back to x64 and worked. The `15.0.0 <= v < 16.0.0` clause is also redundant with the first clause's intent. The simple fix is to keep the original `< 16.0.0` check.
